comment: Dracula. Source: https://github.com/dracula/dracula-theme (README.md, Color Palette). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Dracula Theme; the text is in LICENSE-dracula. Roles: text = Foreground, weak = Comment, rule = Current Line, accent = Purple, run = Cyan, ok = Green, error = Red, add = Green, remove = Red, tint = Selection, code = Current Line, background = Background. Dracula has no blue, so run is its cyan; it has no second background, so tint and code are its selection and current-line colour (the same value). No colour adjusted.
